conditions: HETEROGENEOUS_SWITCH +2 on even cue keys and +1 on odd cue keys at ep6
arms: feedback consensus delta dormant repair based only on consecutive live overlap
metrics: heldout total and post episode6 correctness per condition, repair events, update counts, cache write parity, 16 total slots, SHA256 input signatures
preregistered_classification: SELECTIVE_REPAIR if uniform switch improves over baseline and heterogeneous condition has zero false consensus repair events; FALSE_GENERALIZATION if heterogeneous corrections occur yet worsen accuracy; MIXED otherwise
constraint: No access to unobserved key labels or future truth; identical sources, fixed new cohort, archive negatives, no reruns or post hoc thresholds, full pytest.
